FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'bonsoir' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. no
   B. hello, good day
   C. Pleased to meet you
   D. good evening

2. How do you say 'I have a brother and a sister.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Ma mère s'appelle Grace.
   B. J'ai un frère et une sœur.
   C. Mon père s'appelle David.
   D. Qui est-ce ?

3. What does 'le livre' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the cat
   B. the book
   C. the living room
   D. the table

4. How do you say 'It is a bed.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est un lit.
   B. La télé est dans le salon.
   C. Le tapis est devant le canapé.
   D. Le livre est sur la table.

5. How do you say 'The rug is in front of the sofa.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il y a un canapé dans le salon.
   B. Dans la cuisine, il y a un frigo.
   C. C'est une table.
   D. Le tapis est devant le canapé.

6. How do you say 'On Sunday, I go to church.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le vendredi, je danse.
   B. Le jeudi, je chante.
   C. Le samedi, je joue.
   D. Le dimanche, je vais à l'église.

7. What does 'un cadeau' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. a balloon
   B. a party
   C. a present
   D. a song

8. What does 'le fromage' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. sweets
   B. the orange
   C. cheese
   D. the cake

9. What does 'le poulet' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the carrot
   B. the cake
   C. chicken
   D. chips

10. How do you say 'At midday, I eat rice and beans.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le matin, je mange du pain.
   B. Je bois un jus.
   C. À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots.
   D. Qu'est-ce que c'est ?

11. What does 'la main' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the nose
   B. the eyes
   C. the leg
   D. the hand

12. How do you say 'It is snowing.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il y a des nuages.
   B. Il fait chaud.
   C. Il pleut.
   D. Il neige.

13. What does 'Il y a des nuages.' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is nice.
   B. It is freezing.
   C. It is raining.
   D. It is cloudy.

14. What does 'le temps' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the weather
   B. the wind
   C. the snow
   D. the storm

15. How do you say 'You are welcome!' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Tournez à droite.
   B. De rien !
   C. La télé est sur la table.
   D. Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?

16. How do you say 'Where is the key?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Où est la clé ?
   B. Allez tout droit.
   C. Le lit est dans la chambre.
   D. Elle est sous la chaise.

17. What does 'le magasin' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the key
   B. the shop
   C. the rug
   D. the garden

18. What does 'Bonsoir, Madame !' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Good evening, Madam!
   B. How do you spell it?
   C. Goodbye, Sir.
   D. What is your name?

19. Which little word goes with 'frère' (the brother)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. les
   C. le
   D. l'

20. Which little word goes with 'bébé' (the baby)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. la
   C. le
   D. les

21. What does 'Mon frère s'appelle Kamau.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Here is my grandmother.
   B. This is my brother.
   C. I have a brother and a sister.
   D. My brother is called Kamau.

22. Which little word goes with 'chat' (the cat)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. le
   C. la
   D. les

23. What does 'C'est une table.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. In the kitchen, there is a fridge.
   B. It is a table.
   C. There is a sofa in the living room.
   D. The bag is in the bedroom.

24. Which little word goes with 'salon' (the living room)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. la
   C. le
   D. les

25. Read: Salut ! Je m'appelle Kamau. J'ai dix ans. Le samedi, je joue au football. Le dimanche, je vais à l'église avec ma famille. Question: How old is Kamau? (1 mark)
   A. ten
   B. nine
   C. twelve
   D. eleven

26. What does 'Tu as quel âge ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. How old are you?
   B. My birthday is on 12 May.
   C. I am nine years old.
   D. Thank you very much!

27. What does 'J'ai deux oreilles.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have a nose.
   B. I have a mouth.
   C. I have two ears.
   D. I have ten fingers.

28. What does 'Il y a un orage.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. There is a storm.
   B. It is sunny.
   C. I stay in the house.
   D. It is cold.

29. What does 'Il y a des nuages.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is windy.
   B. It is cloudy.
   C. It is snowing.
   D. It is raining.

30. What does 'La télé est sur la table.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The rug is under the table.
   B. Where is the key?
   C. The fridge is in the kitchen.
   D. The TV is on the table.

31. Which sentence is correctly written? (1 mark)
   A. je mappelle amina
   B. Je m'apelle Amina.
   C. Je m'appelle Amina.
   D. Je m appelle Amina

32. How do you say 'thank you' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Madame
   B. merci
   C. Enchanté
   D. au revoir

33. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'brother'? (1 mark)
   A. frèe
   B. frére
   C. frère
   D. frere

34. How do you say 'the grandfather' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le frère
   B. l'enfant
   C. le grand-père
   D. le garçon

35. How do you say 'the cake' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le gâteau
   B. les fruits
   C. la mangue
   D. le pain

36. How do you say 'the ear' in French? (1 mark)
   A. l'oreille
   B. le pied
   C. le nez
   D. la dent

37. How do you say 'the back' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la bouche
   B. le nez
   C. le dos
   D. les cheveux

38. How do you say 'the cloud' in French? (1 mark)
   A. l'orage
   B. le vent
   C. une inondation
   D. le nuage

39. How do you say 'the wind' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le vent
   B. la neige
   C. le soleil
   D. la pluie

40. How do you say 'the shop' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le jardin
   B. la clé
   C. le magasin
   D. le tapis

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write in French: your birthday is on 25 December. (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Translate into French: 'I like the mango.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

43. Translate into English: 'Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into French: 'On Saturday, I help my mother.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into French: 'I have a mouth.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

46. Translate into English: 'Le chat est derrière la porte.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

47. Translate into English: 'Mon anniversaire, c'est le 30 juin.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Sort into friendly and harsh weather: le soleil, l'orage, le beau temps, le vent très fort. (4 marks) (4 marks)

49. Write four sentences in French about your family. Use mon or ma correctly. (4 marks) (4 marks)

50. Translate into French: 'On Thursday, I sing.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

51. Explain why the order le 12 mai matters and write the date the wrong way for comparison. (3 marks) (3 marks)

52. Translate into French: 'The rug is under the table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

53. Translate into English: 'J'ai neuf ans.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

54. Translate into English: 'Et toi ?' (2 marks) (2 marks)

55. Translate into French: 'The ball is behind the door.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

56. Write the French words for: I dance, I rest, the week (3 marks) (3 marks)

57. Translate into English: 'Joyeux anniversaire !' (2 marks) (2 marks)

58. Write three sentences in French to say where things are in your house. (3 marks) (3 marks)

59. Translate into English: 'Ça va bien, merci.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

60. Translate into English: 'C'est un lit.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

61. Translate into English: 'Voici ma famille.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

62. Translate into French: 'It is snowing.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — good evening
   bonsoir means good evening.

2. B — J'ai un frère et une sœur.
   I have a brother and a sister. in French is J'ai un frère et une sœur.

3. B — the book
   le livre means the book.

4. A — C'est un lit.
   It is a bed. in French is C'est un lit.

5. D — Le tapis est devant le canapé.
   The rug is in front of the sofa. in French is Le tapis est devant le canapé.

6. D — Le dimanche, je vais à l'église.
   On Sunday, I go to church. in French is Le dimanche, je vais à l'église.

7. C — a present
   un cadeau means a present.

8. C — cheese
   le fromage means cheese.

9. C — chicken
   le poulet means chicken.

10. C — À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots.
   At midday, I eat rice and beans. in French is À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots.

11. D — the hand
   la main means the hand.

12. D — Il neige.
   It is snowing. in French is Il neige.

13. D — It is cloudy.
   Il y a des nuages. means It is cloudy..

14. A — the weather
   le temps means the weather.

15. B — De rien !
   You are welcome! in French is De rien !

16. A — Où est la clé ?
   Where is the key? in French is Où est la clé ?

17. B — the shop
   le magasin means the shop.

18. A — Good evening, Madam!
   Bonsoir, Madame ! means Good evening, Madam!

19. C — le
   frère is masculine, so we say le frère.

20. C — le
   bébé is masculine, so we say le bébé.

21. D — My brother is called Kamau.
   Mon frère s'appelle Kamau. means My brother is called Kamau.

22. B — le
   chat is masculine, so we say le chat.

23. B — It is a table.
   C'est une table. means It is a table.

24. C — le
   salon is masculine, so we say le salon.

25. A — ten
   J'ai dix ans.

26. A — How old are you?
   Tu as quel âge ? means How old are you?

27. C — I have two ears.
   J'ai deux oreilles. means I have two ears.

28. A — There is a storm.
   Il y a un orage. means There is a storm.

29. B — It is cloudy.
   Il y a des nuages. means It is cloudy.

30. D — The TV is on the table.
   La télé est sur la table. means The TV is on the table.

31. C — Je m'appelle Amina.
   It has the apostrophe, double l, capital letters and a full stop.

32. B — merci
   thank you in French is merci.

33. C — frère
   The correct spelling is frère, with its accents.

34. C — le grand-père
   the grandfather in French is le grand-père.

35. A — le gâteau
   the cake in French is le gâteau.

36. A — l'oreille
   the ear in French is l'oreille.

37. C — le dos
   the back in French is le dos.

38. D — le nuage
   the cloud in French is le nuage.

39. A — le vent
   the wind in French is le vent.

40. C — le magasin
   the shop in French is le magasin.
